question:
Let \(A\) and \(B\) be two fixed points 3 cm apart.

(a) Let \(P\) be any point not collinear with \(A\) and \(B\), such that \(PA=2PB\). The tangent at \(P\) to the circle passing through the points \(P,A\) and \(B\) meets the extended line \(AB\) at the point \(K\). Find the lengths of the segments \(KB\) and \(KP\).

(b) Hence or otherwise, prove that the locus of all points \(P\) in the plane such that \(PA=2PB\) is a circle.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
